summary: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaei declared the Strait of Hormuz completely closed, contradicting US President Trump's claim that the strait is open. Israeli forces launched strikes across southern Lebanon after Hezbollah fired two explosive drones at IDF troops, with Lebanese health authorities reporting four dead and 20 wounded. Separately, the IDF conducted a surprise general staff drill ("Dawn 2.0") ordered by IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir to test multi-arena readiness ahead of the holiday period.
key_points: Iran's SNSC Secretary Maj. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei declared the Strait of Hormuz completely closed and stated Iran 'sees and strikes American smuggling vessels,' claiming the US spends heavily to push 5–6 vessels through. (Source: @presstv/205760)

Lebanese health authorities report four dead and 20 wounded in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon since this morning, following Hezbollah's launch of two explosive drones at IDF troops. (Source: @manniefabian/59104)

IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir ordered a surprise multi-arena readiness drill dubbed "Dawn 2.0" overnight, testing General Staff, commands, branches, and reserves ahead of the holiday period. (Source: @New_security8200/203636)

Hezbollah fired two explosive drones at IDF troops operating in the security zone in southern Lebanon; troops shot down one drone and the IDF responded with strikes in southern Lebanon. (Source: @idf_telegram/25061)

Lebanese media reported an Israeli airstrike destroyed Ghandour Hospital in Nabatieh al-Fawqa; according to reports the facility was empty of patients and staff at the time. (Source: @manniefabian/59102)

IDF, Shin Bet, and police forces arrested 10 Hamas-affiliated terrorists in the village of Aqqaba under Menashe Brigade command, locating a rocket (without launcher), an M16 rifle, and explosive materials. (Source: @New_security8200/203641)
Iran's IRGC Navy said it targeted a US remotely-operated vessel attempting to enter the 'protected zone' of the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/78249)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned that the era of 'proportional responses' is over and threatened a 'heavier response' to the US, a day after the US struck several Iranian oil tankers in the Persian Gulf. (Source: @mamlekate/104349)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's SNSC Secretary declared the Strait of Hormuz completely closed and claimed Iran is striking American smuggling vessels, marking a sharp escalation in the US-Iran maritime confrontation. The IDF launched strikes across southern Lebanon after Hezbollah fired two explosive drones at troops in the security zone, with Lebanese health authorities reporting four dead and 20 wounded. Concurrently, IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir ordered a surprise general staff exercise ("Dawn 2.0") testing multi-arena readiness ahead of the holiday period.
iran: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaei declared the Strait of Hormuz completely closed and called President Trump's claim that the strait is open 'a massive lie.' He stated Iran 'sees and strikes American smuggling vessels,' claiming the US spends heavily to push 5–6 vessels through and that these ships are usually struck, though Tehran refrains from sinking them because they carry oil. (Source: @presstv/205760)
The IRGC Navy announced in a statement that it targeted a US remotely-operated vessel attempting to enter the 'protected zone' of the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/78249)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated on Sunday 15 Shahrivar that the era of 'proportional responses' is over and threatened a 'heavier response' to the United States, a day after the US struck several Iranian oil tankers in the Persian Gulf. He simultaneously acknowledged serious economic problems inside the country. (Source: @mamlekate/104349)
Iran and Oman agreed on navigation route maps for the Strait of Hormuz and are expected to sign the agreement in coming days, according to Mohsen Rezaei. (Source: @asafroz/53148)

Iranian government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani announced the 'third tier' gasoline price will double to 10,000 toman per liter starting 17 Shahrivar, while monthly quotas of 60 liters at 1,500 toman and 50 liters at 3,000 toman remain unchanged. (Source: @mamlekate/104348)

US Air Force tanker aircraft and fighter jets are reportedly active around the Strait of Hormuz and are helping enforce a siege on Iranian ports, which is cited as the reason the strait is closed today. (Source: @kianmeli1/91584)
Two apartments reportedly linked to Mojtaba Khamenei located near the Israeli embassy in London have been put up for sale on the market. (Source: @mamlekate/104346)
israel: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir ordered a surprise general staff drill called "Dawn 2.0" in the early morning hours to test multi-arena readiness, involving the General Staff, regional commands, branches, and reserves ahead of the holiday period. Zamir stated the drill 'is also a message to our enemies — the IDF is trained and ready to defend the state.' (Source: @New_security8200/203636)

The IDF, Shin Bet, and police conducted a joint operation in the village of Aqqaba under Menashe Brigade command, arresting a Hamas terror infrastructure cell of 10 operatives and locating a rocket (without launcher), an M16 rifle, and substantial explosive materials intended for IED production, all destroyed on site. (Source: @New_security8200/203641)

The IDF responded to the Hezbollah drone attack by striking targets in southern Lebanon, with the IDF Spokesperson calling the drone launch 'a blatant violation by the Hezbollah terror organization.' (Source: @manniefabian/59099)
The IDF struck a vehicle in central Gaza City, with local reports indicating a commander in Hamas's military wing was eliminated in the strike. (Source: @yediotnews25/134723)

The IDF Home Front Command warned that intensive explosion noises would be heard in the northern Gaza envelope area and specifically in Sderot and the Sha'ar HaNegev Regional Council area in the coming hours as part of ongoing operations in the Strip. (Source: @New_security8200/203654)
Israeli police received a report of a suspected shooting incident in the Givat Shaul neighborhood of Jerusalem; MDA evacuated a 30-year-old man in serious condition. (Source: @yediotnews25/134724)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is markedly more dangerous, with Iran's Supreme National Security Council publicly declaring the Strait of Hormuz completely closed and claiming Iranian forces are striking American smuggling vessels — a direct challenge to US freedom of navigation assertions. Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf's threat of a 'heavier response' to the US strike on Iranian oil tankers signals an intent to escalate beyond the maritime domain. The simultaneous Israeli response to Hezbollah's drone attack in southern Lebanon, combined with the IDF's surprise multi-arena readiness drill ordered by Chief of Staff Zamir, indicates heightened multi-front contingency posture ahead of the holiday period.
sections.regional_response: Iran's coordination with Oman on Strait of Hormuz navigation route maps suggests Tehran is pursuing diplomatic cover alongside its military closure posture, potentially leveraging the agreement to legitimize its control over the waterway. Iraq-based channels report on the German Saxony-Anhalt election results showing the AfD at 44%, reflecting broader European political turbulence but with no direct regional security implications identified in the data. Lebanese media continues to report civilian infrastructure damage in southern Lebanon, including the destruction of Ghandour Hospital in Nabatieh al-Fawqa.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple independent Iranian sources confirm the Strait of Hormuz closure claim, including the SNSC Secretary, the IRGC Navy, and pro-government outlets, suggesting coordinated messaging rather than isolated rhetoric. The IDF's simultaneous launch of a surprise general staff drill while conducting active operations in Lebanon and Gaza indicates a deliberate posture of readiness signaling ahead of a sensitive holiday period. The reported targeting of a US remotely-operated vessel (rather than a crewed ship) by the IRGC Navy suggests an Iranian strategy calibrated to pressure the US without triggering a major kinetic escalation.
